mechanism: Tizanidine (alpha-2 agonist) causes CNS depression and hypotension while lisdexamfetamine (sympathomimetic stimulant) increases sympathetic activity, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects and increased risk of cardiovascular instability and CNS effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor closely for blood pressure changes, heart rate abnormalities, sedation, and reduced efficacy of either agent; consider alternative muscle relaxant or stimulant medication.
